r: Drivers of mobility – **health, education, technology, institutions**; low mobility **entrenches historical inequality**; poverty **21.9% (2011-12) → 2.3% (2023-24)**
Seek OBC status mainly for **greater life chances**
Toddy tapping → tailoring (occupational mobility); city anonymity weakens caste
State policy, reform movements, Sanskritisation and Westernisation; **most influential factor (studies):** **collective action** – movements and political mobilisation
**Kakatiya** society relatively open (**Velamas, Kammas, Reddys** rose); **Saivism (Virashaivism)** a "**lubricant**" of upward mobility
By land rights and income – **Maliks** (landlords on rent), **Kisans** (own land, family labour), **Mazdoors** (tenants, sharecroppers, landless)
A concept for **stratification in rural India**
→ English-educated middle class (**A.R. Desai**, *Social Background of Indian Nationalism*)
World Bank **$10-50**/day (PPP); NCAER **₹2-10 lakh**; PRICE **₹5-30 lakh**; **43.2 crore (31%) in 2021 → 61% by 2047**; OECD: world's largest by **2035**
